# Incorrect Account Numbers: PROD connectivity testing

_Category: Tips and Hints · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Melissa** (1/21/2022):

Prod Connectivity Testing is complete. Thank you for verifying your connections. 

We've identified that a few users connected using account numbers from the specs. If you entered the account number as PA87074 or PS12345 during testing you will need to correct this value for go-live to ensure you can complete transactions and payments. The account number is located int he Account Info tab in the portal. Feel free to message our team for support in locating this!
